statement: A publicly available model will score ≥90% on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
resolution_criterion: Any public leaderboard or vendor-published, independently reproducible result at or above 90% on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

statement: A major lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google DeepMind) will publish research specifically on calibration or self-assessed confidence for agentic tasks.
resolution_criterion: An official paper or research blog post from one of the three named labs whose primary subject is confidence/calibration in agentic (multi-step, tool-using) settings.

statement: An open-weights model will hold a top-3 position on the LMArena overall text leaderboard.
resolution_criterion: Screenshot-able top-3 placement on the main text leaderboard at any point before the deadline.

statement: US year-over-year CPI inflation will print below 3.0% in the BLS release covering November 2026.
resolution_criterion: Headline CPI-U YoY figure in the official BLS release.
note: Made with acknowledged uncertainty about the current print — that's part of the exercise.

statement: Study 2 (introspective accuracy: do a model's claims about its own behavior predict that model's measured behavior better than they predict other models'?) will be published on this site.
resolution_criterion: A completed writeup in Work with frozen data.
resolution_note: Resolved early by author's choice: the planned study was found substantially preempted (Binder et al. 2024 and successors) and was replaced by the Handoff Study. Scored as a miss at 80% confidence — the ledger does not care that the reason was good.

statement: At least one researcher I cold-email will send a substantive reply (engaging with the work's content, not a pleasantry).
resolution_criterion: Judged by me in public, with the reasoning posted, quoting no private text without permission.
